row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public prices; plans Foundation, Growth, Scale)
row.evidence: Scrut's help centre says "The Manage Users section in Settings allows you to create, edit and remove users in Scrut" and documents only OIDC/social SSO for sign-in; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre, developer docs or API reference.
row.notes: Quote-only: scrut.io/pricing is 404 and the site routes buyers to a demo request ('All-inclusive pricing. No paywalled features or surprise add-ons.'); the developer docs name Foundation, Growth and Scale plans without prices. No SCIM: platform users (Admin, Contributor, Auditor) are added, deactivated and deleted by hand in Settings > Manage Users. Enterprise SSO (Google Workspace, Entra, Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud, PingOne) plus Google/Microsoft social login; the Okta OIN app is OIDC only. Scrut's IdP and HRIS integrations read users and groups into its People/Employees module for compliance evidence and the training portal; they do not provision Scrut platform accounts. The public REST API has no user endpoints. SSO plan gate not published.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented for Scrut. User lifecycle is manual in Settings > Manage Users; deactivation ends active sessions and deletion is permanent.

rate_limits.text: 50 requests per 60 seconds per credential on /v1 data endpoints; 10 per 60 seconds on the token endpoint.

limitations.text: The public Scrut API (Foundation, Growth and Scale plans) covers frameworks, policies, controls, evidence, tests and vulnerabilities only; no user, role or group endpoints are documented.

user_api.notes: A REST API exists (regional base URLs api.scrut.io, api.us.scrut.io, api.eu.scrut.io, api.au.scrut.io) but it is not a user-management API, so available is false.

okta.notes: The OIN 'Scrut Automation' OIDC app marks only OIDC (read from page markup). A second OIN listing is an Okta API Service Integration that lets Scrut read users, groups and roles from Okta for compliance evidence; it does not provision Scrut accounts.

entra.notes: No Scrut entry in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial index; Scrut's own SSO settings page lists Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) as a supported enterprise SSO.

google.notes: Scrut's SSO settings page lists Google Workspace as an enterprise SSO option; no Google Workspace Marketplace/admin catalogue page was checked.

onelogin.notes: Scrut creates an OIDC app in the customer's OneLogin portal through the OneLogin API (vendor guide); OneLogin's own catalogue page was not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: Customer creates a custom OIDC SSO app in JumpCloud per Scrut's guide; no JumpCloud catalogue page was found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, OneLogin, JumpCloud and HRIS (BambooHR, Zoho People) integrations sync users/employees into the People module for compliance tracking and the employee training portal; not provisioning of platform users.
